soldier: Head and antennae brownish yellow, nasus reddish brown, thorax and abdomen pale brown, legs yellowish white. Head nearly bare, the tip of the nasus with a few hairs. Large form: head flattened-round, wider than long, the sides broadly bulging behind the mid-point, the middle of the posterior margin nearly straight; nasus a stout cone, shorter than the head, upturned in profile with the tip slightly higher than the top of the head, the base of the nasus shallowly concave, the angle between nasus and head slightly greater than 120°; mandibles with a short apical spine. Antennae 13 segments, the second to fourth nearly equal in length, the third about 1.5 times the second. The anterior raised part of the pronotum strongly sclerotised and with a median incision. Small form: colour rather brighter and paler, head capsule nearly circular and wider than long, nasus shorter than the head, upturned in profile with the tip higher than the top of the head, the base of the nasus shallowly concave, the angle about 115°, the apical spine of the mandibles short and small; antennae 12 segments, the second the shortest, the third slightly longer than the second; anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both nearly straight.
